_readme: Elton draft. [[c:...]] is cyan = not confirmed. History from the Elton Parish Council short history unless noted.
name: Highgate Green and Highgate Hall

layers.essential_history: [[c:Highgate Hall began life as the village Reading Room. It was made bigger in the 1930s, and today the parish council meets here.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:After the First World War the village population fell below 550, the lowest for centuries.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Here you find Thomas Wade's neighbour, who knows where the miller was at midnight.]]

sources.title: Elton Parish Council: A short history of Elton

directions_to_next: [[c:Walk back west along Main Street and turn right into Hayes Walk, about 300 metres.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Where was the miller?]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Only one person could NOT have been at the mill at midnight.]]
material: [[c:NEIGHBOUR: "Thomas was home all night with his poorly little boy. I sat with them myself until dawn."]]
[[c:APPRENTICE: "Master Hale asked Thomas for the mill key so his horses could shelter in the yard."]]
[[c:STABLE BOY: "A rider went out after midnight towards the river."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who could NOT have been at the mill at midnight? (surname)]]
hints: [[c:Look for someone with a witness all night.]]
[[c:The neighbour sat with him until dawn.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Thomas Wade was home all night with his sick son. He only lent the key. Someone else used it.]]

evidence: [[c:Thomas Wade was at home all night. He lent the mill key to Master Hale.]]
